## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `Logging`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `logging`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **Logging**.

## Step 2: Add a log statement

1. <!-- manual: On the integration canvas, open the node panel and expand the Logging section. -->
2. Select **Log Info** (or **Log Warn**, **Log Error**, **Log Debug**) to add the node.
3. <!-- manual: Fill the Msg field with the message to log. Msg supports Ballerina string templates, so you can embed expressions such as Order ${orderId} received . -->

## Step 3: Add context with key-value pairs

1. <!-- manual: Open the Log node form. -->
2. Select **Advanced Configurations**.
3. <!-- manual: Add each context field as a key-value pair. -->
